title: Whole Blood Processing Using SepMate
author: Yang Sun
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba87ihzn

steps.title: Initial Blood Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge whole blood samples within 6 hours of collection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1200 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature using a swinging-out rotor with the brake off.

steps.title: Plasma Separation and Purification
steps.instruction: Isolate and purify plasma from the centrifuged blood.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer 3 mL of plasma into a 15 mL tube, avoiding the buffy coat; leave the clear layer at least 1 cm above the RBC to minimize PBMC loss.
Centrifuge plasma at 16000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C in a fixed-angle rotor (if a high-speed 15 mL centrifuge is unavailable, aliquot into multiple 1.5 mL tubes and centrifuge at 16000 x g).
Transfer plasma to new tubes, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Plasma Aliquoting and Storage
steps.instruction: Store purified plasma in low-bind tubes.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 1 mL of plasma into multiple 1.5 mL low-bind tubes.
Freeze at -20 °C on the day of collection.
Move samples to -80 °C after 24 hours.

steps.title: Prepare SepMate Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare SepMate tubes with Lymphoprep for PBMC isolation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2-3 SepMate tubes per donor (depending on blood volume).
Add 15 mL of Lymphoprep below the insert by pipetting into the center hole, minimizing air bubbles below the plastic divider.

steps.title: Blood Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the residual whole blood 1:2 with Ca/Mg-free DPBS.

substeps.instruction: For 105 mL total: mix 35 mL residual blood with 70 mL DPBS.
For 42 mL total: mix 14 mL residual blood with 28 mL DPBS.

steps.title: Load Blood into SepMate Tubes
steps.instruction: Carefully load the diluted blood into the prepared SepMate tubes.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pipette diluted blood (e.g., 35 mL or 21 mL) down the side of the tube.
Ensure no mixing occurs under the divider and do not tilt the tube during addition.

steps.title: Primary Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the SepMate tubes to separate layers.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 1200 x g for 15 minutes at 20 °C with brakes ON.
Prepare destination 50 mL tubes (~30 mL yield per tube for the 105 mL protocol; ~25 mL yield per tube for the 42 mL protocol).

steps.title: Collect Top Layer
steps.instruction: Recover the top layer from the SepMate tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pour off the top layer into the prepared destination tubes.
Do not invert the tubes for more than 2 seconds.

steps.title: First Cell Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the collected cells.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 450 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature with brake ON.
Pour off supernatant.
Add EasySep buffer to 50 mL (can be scaled to 30 mL to save reagents).

steps.title: Second Cell Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash to further purify cells.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 350 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature with brakes ON. If the supernatant is opaque, repeat or perform the spin at 450 x g.
Pour off supernatant and wash again with 50 mL EasySep buffer.
Spin at 350 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature with brakes on.
Pour off supernatant and resuspend cells in 20 mL EasySep buffer.
Perform cell count.

steps.title: Final Concentration and Cryopreservation
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for long-term storage in cryovials.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 350 x g for 10 minutes and resuspend in the appropriate volume of freezing media A to achieve a concentration of 10e7 cells/mL.
Prepare cryovials containing 500 µL of freezing media B.
Add 500 µL of the cell suspension to each cryovial and gently mix by pipetting.
Place in a freezing container at -80 °C for 1 day, then move to an LN2 tank for long-term storage.
